summary: Model node:timers/promises setInterval as an async iterator yielding the supplied value at timer intervals.

target.notes: Integrate with the Node-compatible timer scheduler and existing JsPromise/async-iteration semantics.

semantics.yield: each successful interval iteration yields the same supplied value
semantics.delay: default 1 ms with Node timer normalization
semantics.options: ref defaults true; signal may abort
semantics.consumption: next()/for-await controls observation; iterator integrates with generic async iteration semantics

caveats: Do not translate to IEnumerable<T>; next() is asynchronous and cancellation/error behavior is observable.
for-await control flow remains owned by ASYNC.

tests.name: yields repeated values
tests.expected_behavior: prints x twice then exits the loop

tests.name: is async not eager sequence
tests.expected_behavior: prints true; values are produced through async next() operations
